conversations.value: Generate a photorealistic image of a snow-capped mountain at sunset, with golden light illuminating the peaks and a crystal-clear alpine lake in the foreground reflecting the sky.

Create a cyberpunk cityscape at night. Neon signs in Japanese and English, rain-slicked streets reflecting pink and blue lights, flying cars in the distance, and a lone figure with a holographic umbrella.

Draw two cat sketches in the style of a field guide illustrator: one sitting alertly facing left, and one curled up sleeping facing right. Use fine ink lines with minimal shading on a cream background.

Design an educational infographic about the water cycle. Include labeled arrows showing evaporation, condensation, precipitation, and collection. Use a clean flat-design style with blue and green color palette. Add a small sun, clouds, mountains, and ocean.
